marketplace/checkout-page/scheduled-orde.test_name: Scheduled Order Checkout [657464] Select a time slot and save

attempts.hypothesis: ScheduledOrdersSection.openTimeDropdown() never interacts with the checkout's day-select dropdown and assumes the default day ("Today") always has time slots; when the earliest bookable slot rolls past midnight into a different day-of-week bucket, the time list is permanently empty and the 30s toPass retry can never succeed.
attempts.fix_applied: openTimeDropdown() now detects the empty-slot-list state (noSlotsMessage) and falls back to selecting the next day in the day-select before retrying, mirroring real shopper behavior.
attempts.result: red (reverted fix reproduces exact nightly error) / green / revert / restore proven via temporary repro fixture forcing today's bucket empty; 20/20 Vape isolation ✅; load-realistic run (6-worker parallel, dutchie-e2e constellation, 3/3) ✅
